const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('.')
task=root/'.ai/task/repair-w31-20260925'
out=root/'evidence/quality/repair-window-31-20260925'
d=json.loads((task/'PACK-MANIFEST.json').read_bytes())
counts={'absent':0,'same':0,'different':0}
errors=[]
for e in d['files']:
    s=root/e['source']; b=s.read_bytes(); h=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
    if h!=e['sha256'] or len(b)!=e['bytes']: errors.append((str(s),h,len(b),e['sha256'],e['bytes']))
    t=out/'orchestration'/e['relative_destination']
    k='absent' if not t.exists() else ('same' if t.read_bytes()==b else 'different')
    counts[k]+=1
    if k=='different': errors.append(('DEST_DIFF',str(t)))
print('pack_files',len(d['files']),'total_bytes',sum(e['bytes'] for e in d['files']))
print('pack_dest',counts)
print('pack_errors',len(errors))
for x in errors[:20]: print(x)
manifest_target=out/'orchestration-pack-manifest.json'
print('manifest_target', 'absent' if not manifest_target.exists() else ('same' if manifest_target.read_bytes()==(task/'PACK-MANIFEST.json').read_bytes() else 'different'))

cand=root/'.artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window31-20260925-candidate-catalog'
for s in sorted(p for p in cand.rglob('*') if p.is_file()):
    t=root/s.relative_to(cand)
    print('candidate',s.relative_to(cand),'->',('absent' if not t.exists() else ('same' if t.read_bytes()==s.read_bytes() else 'replace')))

pub=out/'publication'
sources=[task/'PUBLICATION-SCOPE.md',task/'CATALOG-CHANGE-VERIFICATION.json',task/'MIGRATION-HOST-VERIFICATION.json',task/'TRANSLATION-COMMIT.json']
sources+=sorted(task.glob('ADJUDICATION-*.json'))+sorted(task.glob('HOST-NOTE-*.json'))
for s in sources:
    t=pub/s.name
    print('publication',t.name,('absent' if not t.exists() else ('same' if t.read_bytes()==s.read_bytes() else 'replace')))
for name in ['publish-chain.log','publish-chain-timing.json','migration.json','migration-timing.json']:
    s=root/'.artifacts/i18n/repair-window'/('window31-20260925-'+name); t=pub/name
    print('publication',t.name,('absent' if not t.exists() else ('same' if t.read_bytes()==s.read_bytes() else 'replace')))
